sample.heading: Demonstration reading sample
sample.text:
A dependable application makes its state understandable. When work is waiting, show that it is waiting. When a step fails, keep the information the person entered and explain what can happen next.

For a small exercise, sketch three versions of the same screen: before loading, after loading, and after a recoverable failure. Decide which action helps the reader in each state. Then give those states names in the model before choosing their colors or icons.
